Ich is the most common fish illness in the freshwater aquarium hobby. Luckily, it is pretty easy to treat. The first step is positively identifying the parasitic infection. The infection looks like grains of white sand or salt all over the fishes fins, gills and eventually scales. The finnage may also appear tattered, and the fish may display flashing behavior, which looks like it is scratching its body on the substrate or ornaments to itch a scratch. Eventually, without treatment, as the infection progresses, the parasites attach themselves to the gills and the fish will settle at the bottom gasping, and eventually expire.
